properties.text: Malformed blob tx RLP must be rejected gracefully without crashing the node process.
properties.assertion: forall p2p_msg: decode_blob_tx(msg.rlp) either succeeds or raises caught exception; no unhandled crash

properties.text: tx.BlobVersionedHashes length must equal wrapper Blobs/Commitments/Proofs length.
properties.assertion: forall blob_tx: len(tx.BlobVersionedHashes) == len(wrapper.Blobs) == len(wrapper.Commitments) == len(wrapper.Proofs)

metadata.note: Manual additions for issues #176 (malformed blob tx crash) and #210 (declared vs actual blob hash count mismatch)
